2607.01470.title: World Feedback for Clinical Agents: Diagnosing RL in FHIR Environments
2607.01470.paper_summary: Clinical protocol-execution tasks -- checking a lab value, applying a threshold, placing a correctly structured FHIR order -- are natural candidates for RL from world feedback: once clinical SMEs encode decision logic into a verifier, that verifier grades unlimited rollouts without per-episode annotation. But applying RL requires a sound feedback channel and sufficient base capability. We audit MedAgentBench v1/v2, find a 41.7\% silent-finish ceiling that makes inaction the RL dominant strategy, and construct \textbf{MedAgentBench-v3 (MAB-v3)} (508 tasks, 8.9\% ceiling). Training Qwen3-8B exposes two structural barriers: a \emph{capability ceiling} (10/20 task types have 0\% base performance, zero gradient) and a \emph{format-knowledge barrier} (3/20 types require exact clinical codes undiscoverable by exploration). Pure RL reaches 18.2\% pass@1 vs.\ 34.1\% for rule-based SFT; the 15.9~pp gap is attributable entirely to these barriers. A decision/format-knowledge/lookup taxonomy predicts RL learnability and prescribes the fix: SFT to inject codes, RL to learn conditionals.
2607.01470.paper_summary_zh: 臨床協議執行任務——檢查實驗室數值、應用閾值、下達正確結構的FHIR訂單——是來自世界反饋的強化學習（RL）的自然候選者：一旦臨床專家將決策邏輯編碼到驗證器中，該驗證器便可以在沒有每次註釋的情況下對無限制的執行進行評分。但應用RL需要一個穩健的反饋通道和足夠的基本能力。我們審核了MedAgentBench v1/v2，發現41.7\%的靜默完成上限使得不行動成為RL的主導策略，並構建了\textbf{MedAgentBench-v3 (MAB-v3)}（508個任務，8.9\%上限）。訓練Qwen3-8B暴露了兩個結構性障礙：一個是\emph{能力上限}（10/20個任務類型的基本性能為0\%，無梯度），另一個是\emph{格式知識障礙}（3/20類型需要精確的臨床代碼，無法通過探索發現）。純RL的通過率為18.2\% vs. 34.1\%的基於規則的SFT；15.9~pp的差距完全可以歸因於這些障礙。一個決策/格式知識/查找的分類法預測了RL的可學習性並規定了修正方案：SFT注入代碼，RL學習條件。
